title: MLEvolve: A Self-Evolving Framework for Automated Machine Learning Algorithm Discovery
abstract: arXiv:2606.06473v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly applied to long-horizon tasks such as scientific discovery and machine learning engineering (MLE), where sustained self-evolution becomes a key capability. However, existing MLE agents suffer from isolated exploration, inefficient experience reuse, and lack of hierarchical control, which together hinder long-horizon optimization. We present MLEvolve, an LLM-based self-evolving multi-agent framework for end-to-end machine learning algorithm discovery. By extending tree search to Progressive MCGS, MLEvolve enables cross-branch information flow through graph-based reference edges and gradually shifts the search from broad exploration to focused exploitation with an entropy-inspired progressive schedule. To allow the agent to evolve with accumulated experience, we introduce Retrospective Memory, which combines a cold-start domain knowledge base with a dynamic global memory for task

translated_title: MLEvolve：一个用于自动化机器学习算法发现的自进化框架
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体正越来越多地被应用于科学发现和机器学习工程（MLE）等长程任务，在这些任务中，持续的自我进化成为一项关键能力。然而，现有的MLE智能体存在探索孤立、经验复用低效以及缺乏分层控制等问题，这些问题共同阻碍了长程优化。我们提出了MLEvolve，一个基于LLM的自进化多智能体框架，用于端到端的机器学习算法发现。通过将树搜索扩展为渐进式MCGS（Progressive MCGS），MLEvolve通过基于图的引用边实现跨分支信息流，并借助受熵启发的渐进式调度，将搜索从广泛探索逐渐转向聚焦利用。为了让智能体能够随着经验的积累而不断进化，我们引入了回顾性记忆，它将冷启动领域知识库与动态全局记忆相结合，用于任务（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: MLEvolve是一个基于大语言模型的自进化多智能体框架，通过渐进式MCGS树搜索实现跨分支信息流与探索-利用的渐进转变，并借助结合领域知识库与动态全局记忆的回顾性记忆机制，实现端到端的机器学习算法自动发现。
en_tdlr: MLEvolve is an LLM-based self-evolving multi-agent framework that enables end-to-end automated machine learning algorithm discovery through Progressive MCGS tree search with cross-branch information flow and a Retrospective Memory combining a domain knowledge base with dynamic global memory.
